cta.table_pt: Abre uma Mesa e vota sem instalar a app

restaurant_reel.command: cd remotion && node scripts/pick-subjects.mjs --kind restaurant --limit 1 && node scripts/run-batch.mjs --kind restaurant --limit 1

review_spotlight.command: cd remotion && node scripts/pick-subjects.mjs --kind review --limit 1 && node scripts/run-batch.mjs --kind review --limit 1

list_reel.command: cd remotion && node scripts/pick-subjects.mjs --kind list --limit 1 && node scripts/run-batch.mjs --kind list --limit 1

iterations.label: Open on a real count
iterations.hook_rule: First frame is mention count, review count, or save count from props. No adjectives.
iterations.caption_shape: number → who said it → save CTA

iterations.label: Open on the rating that actually exists
iterations.hook_rule: Use the on-platform or Google rating already in props. Attribution follows the source.
iterations.caption_shape: rating + source badge → one quote → CTA

iterations.label: Lead with a real review line
iterations.hook_rule: First spoken/on-screen line is a usable quote. Empty if none.

iterations.label: Lead with the place, not the vibe word
iterations.hook_rule: City or neighbourhood from the row. Never invent a barrio.

iterations.label: People keep saving this
iterations.hook_rule: Only if save or mention count is in props. Otherwise fall back to count_hook.
iterations.caption_shape: saves → why the quotes agree → CTA

iterations.label: The quote carries the scene
iterations.hook_rule: One usable quote on screen, attributed.

iterations.label: Short excerpt, full quote in caption
iterations.hook_rule: On-screen line ≤ MAX_LINE_CHARS; caption has the rest, still attributed.

iterations.label: Name the person, then the plate
iterations.hook_rule: Handle or display name first. No anonymous 'a user'.

iterations.label: Read-it-like-a-voice-note
iterations.hook_rule: Keep the quote intact. Do not punch-up wording.

iterations.label: N spots, counted down
iterations.hook_rule: Open on list length from props.

iterations.label: One night, this list
iterations.hook_rule: Use the list title. Do not invent an occasion the title does not state.

iterations.label: Three to screenshot
iterations.hook_rule: First three usable spots only if MIN_LIST_PLACES is met.

iterations.label: Stay in one area
iterations.hook_rule: Only if places share a city. REVIEW.md already warns when they do not.

iterations.label: Show the feature in three beats
iterations.hook_rule: Copy must match remotion FeatureShowcase strings. Do not paraphrase.

iterations.label: Name the mess, then the button
iterations.hook_rule: Problem from the pack. Feature name and CTA from FEATURES.

iterations.label: Maps graveyard → a NomNom list
iterations.hook_rule: Before = status quo. After = named feature. No fake metrics.

iterations.label: Beat / beat / CTA
iterations.hook_rule: Use the three beats already in FEATURES.

iterations.label: Weekly ritual (Friday spin, Sunday list)
iterations.hook_rule: Ritual is a habit prompt, not a claim that users already do it.

iterations.label: Trending food news + trocadilho
iterations.hook_rule: Story in ≥2 of 5 sources. Name source and date in the caption.

iterations.label: Portugal-first food news
iterations.hook_rule: Prefer PT stories. Skip if nothing clears the virality bar.

iterations.label: Non-food headline, food twist
iterations.hook_rule: Still news-tied. No tragedy, no identity fights.

iterations.label: Ask them to save a list
Practical how-to
iterations.hook_rule: Steps match the product. No invented UI.

iterations.label: Named-source trust piece
iterations.hook_rule: No fake study numbers. Argument, not dataset.

iterations.label: Occasion guide without fake venues
iterations.hook_rule: Teach the list pattern. Do not name restaurants that are not in content/.

iterations.label: Ship or refresh a /features page
iterations.hook_rule: Align with FEATURES copy.

iterations.label: Status-quo pain
iterations.hook_rule: No fake social proof.

iterations.label: Real review language
iterations.hook_rule: Only quotes already in the DB or omitted.

iterations.label: Named feature
iterations.hook_rule: Roulette, Circle, List, Table, Map — branded names.

iterations.label: Stars vs named people
iterations.hook_rule: Do not name competitors. Position by what we do.
